title: redact leaves a GUID that follows a hyphen, which the leak scan flags, so query-log delivery stalls
goal: redact.redact replaces every GUID that kbcommon.leak_hits flags as guid, a GUID that follows a hyphen (a docs URL slug such as some-page-<guid>) included, so a redacted query-log row never fails the store's leak scan and apply --push does not stall on it; kb/_self/querylog.md says the redactor and the scan agree on a hyphen-led GUID

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import redact, kbcommon; g = '-'.join(x * n for x, n in (('a', 8), ('b', 4), ('c', 4), ('d', 4), ('e', 12))); out = redact.redact('/en-us/troubleshoot/some-page-' + g); sys.exit(0 if not [h for h in kbcommon.leak_hits(out) if h[0] == 'guid'] else 1)

notes: Found 2026-10-22: query-log delivery was refused from 2026-10-21 15:38 to 2026-10-22 (59 runs, 49 entries undelivered) because fetches[6].path of two run files ended in a docs URL GUID slug: redact.GUID (_tools/redact.py:52) has (?<![\w-]) so it skips a GUID after '-', while kbcommon.LEAK_GUID (_tools/kbcommon.py:219) uses \b and flags it. Worked around with querylog.py reredact (backup store-reredact-20261022T221812Z), check then problems=0. The next such fetch stalls delivery again.
